parent_activities.connection_moment_sub: Children co-create a shared imaginary world where ideas are visible, named, and valued by the group.
parent_activities.prompt_3: "What does it do in our world?"
parent_activities.why_this_activity_desc: Encourages children to see completely new things from subtle movements in their bodies, then celebrate body movement and define them. Helps imagination, group creativity, and body spatial thinking.
parent_activities.step_2: Explain: "We are going to create shapes that don't exist in the world."
parent_activities.step_3: Each child uses their body to form a unique shape (standing, lying, bending, combining movements).
parent_activities.step_4: Other children observe and interpret what they see.
parent_activities.step_5: Encourage discussion about shapes, sizes, and features.
parent_activities.step_6: Creator explains what their shape "does" or "is used for."
parent_activities.step_7: Rotate turns so each child becomes a creator.
parent_activities.step_8: Build a collection of invented shapes as the session continues.
parent_activities.level_1_desc: Focus on holding a single interesting pose for 10 seconds.
parent_activities.level_2_desc: Connect with one partner using hands or feet only.
parent_activities.level_3_desc: All participants connect into one single, massive organism.
parent_activities.level_4_desc: The "Impossible Shape" begins to move across the room as one unit.
